authority_rule: Report/review output is evidence subject to separate validator/owner decision; a model or deterministic tool cannot mint session/run authority by writing a report.
human_model_rule: HUMAN producer/reviewer omits MODEL_ID; model producer/reviewer requires exact MODEL_ID. Unknown version blocks exact model attribution, not retention of raw report.
immutability: All task/delegation/report/review/tool records append-only; correction is linked new record, no removal of rejected output.
record_flow: Register immutable human/model/tool identity, exact version/config and digest.
Commit TASK with actor and operation scope.
Commit DELEGATION with delegator/delegate/model/scope when a model subagent is used.
Store raw REPORT bytes and digest before parse; preserve rejected/incorrect reports.
Commit REVIEW and DECISION with reviewer identity, evidence, outcome and rationale.
For deterministic TOOL_INVOCATION, bind input digest and PRESENT output digest or distinct NO_OUTPUT/UNKNOWN state.
registered_model_families: future model with exact registered version/config
